embers.research.page.glimmer_page_2.desc: By encasing the crystal in a metal cage you've fashioned it into a lamp. With this, you can launch the light sources, allowing you to place them at a distance. This does come with fewer uses and slower recharging in sunlight.
embers.tooltip.craft_lens_0: You can §ecraft§r a §eTinker's Lens§r to see where to input §eember§r.
embers.tooltip.research: Hold Ctrl to open codex entry
embers.tooltip.research.world: Ctrl + Right Click to open codex entry
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.atmos: Doubles speed but limits Hearth Coil to blasting recipes.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.catal: Increases speed at the cost of gaseous fuel.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.char_: Doubles speed but limits Hearth Coil to smoking recipes.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.clock: Allows controlling the speed of machines with redstone.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.ember: Inverts the Copper Charger to drain items instead.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.entro: Allows alchemy recipes to be slightly off from their true recipe but adds a small chance to fail.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.excav: Allows bore to perform excavation recipes in addition to boring recipes.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.geolo: Produces bonus output from molten ores.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.heat_: Multiplies produced ember by 0.9 but adds flat bonus of 300.
Reduces cooling speed by 30% and adds 75 max heat.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.mini_: Boils fluids when the attached machine consumes/produces ember.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.mnemo: Inscribes successful alchemy recipes on paper for future reference.
embers.tooltip.upgrade.desc.embers.wildf: Reduces ember consumption at the cost of gaseous fuel.
